scope: Complete the low-level DXF writer identity translation for a typed LEADER group-340 annotation reference while preserving the whole-file adapter's source-bound forward-reference behavior.

field.role: Hard reference to the associated annotation
field.preexistingRoute: Whole-file dx_iface output preplans a unique typed annotation target and resolves the source handle through sourceHandleToMintedMap. Ambiguous or missing targets are refused.

priority: Use the whole-file planned source-to-minted annotation identity when available.
Otherwise use the configured reference resolver's final output identity.
Otherwise use an explicit source-handle remap only when that source key exists.
implementation.failureBehavior: A nonzero source reference that resolves or remaps to zero/DRW::NoHandle, an ambiguous whole-file source identity, or an unmapped direct reference refuses the staged LEADER record. A zero source annotHandle retains the existing optional-no-reference path. The resolver result is not remapped again.
implementation.compatibility: No public data layout or virtual interface changed. Existing whole-file planned forward-reference behavior remains the highest-priority path.

controls: explicit source remap emits the mapped group-340 identity
configured resolver takes precedence over an explicit remap
zero resolver result refuses without changing an existing destination prefix
NoHandle remap result refuses without changing an existing destination prefix
nonzero reference with no planned target, resolver, or explicit remap remains refused
existing dx_iface forward-reference integration emits and re-reads the annotation target identity
validation.result: PASS; focused CTest 1/1 and adapter integration selector PASS

limits: This proves final output-ID selection for the bounded field, not target existence or uniqueness for the direct low-level route.
No source owner role, recursive dependency closure, physical DWG producer profile, native annotation evaluation, or rendering semantics are established.
next: Continue the source/parser-contract-backed typed reference-ID audit for supported records. Add output-ID projection only where the field role and correct mapping are established; defer target-kind, owner, and graph claims until qualified source/output providers close them.
